scope: Narrow deterministic ContextPacker and CCR probe baseline for Phase 3 entry; it is not validation of the public envelope contract.

source_decisions.claim: A temporary-file ContextPacker probe exposes raw/packed metrics, preserves one required fact, and returns insufficient-budget when a requested fact is absent.
The probe reports a successful local CCR retrieval and a failed missing-chunk lookup; it does not independently bind a stored hash to a retrieval assertion.

evidence.fixture_scope: context_cases.json schema check only; behavior assertions use temporary inputs in the test
assertions: packing exposes raw/packed token metrics and non-negative probe-reported token savings
a missing mandatory fact produces an inconclusive insufficient-budget outcome
CCR reports a successful retrieval and rejects a missing chunk

limitations: This gate does not attest the P3 public ToolResult envelope, selected evidence identifiers, omission reasons, recovery-handle schema, corpus-level token reduction, or byte-for-byte CCR restoration.
P3-T01 and P3-T02 must add direct red/green contract evidence before enabling those behaviors.
